title: Diane Powell's inbox full of parents saying their children read their thoughts

tellings.quote: email box was filled of parents reaching out saying saying I'm finding that my child can read my thoughts

plain: Around 2022, Diane Powell's email inbox reportedly filled with messages from parents who said, "I'm finding that my child can read my thoughts." Ky Dickens, the filmmaker behind a documentary series about telepathy called The Telepathy Tapes, tells Michels this as part of how her own work began. If the parents are right, it would mean some children can share thoughts without words.
